title: Fix EC2 shallow fetch non-fast-forward on deploy

pr.title: Fix EC2 shallow fetch non-fast-forward on deploy
pr.body:
## Summary
- Deploy failed on merge of #11 because EC2 `git fetch --depth=1` rejected updating `origin/main` as non-fast-forward.
- Prefix the refspec with `+` so the shallow remote-tracking ref can move to the new tip.

## Test plan
- [ ] Re-run Deploy to EC2 on main (or merge this and confirm the workflow succeeds past fetch/checkout)
- [ ] Confirm prod health check still passes after deploy-prod.sh


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

commitMessage:
Force shallow fetch refspec on EC2 deploy.

Depth-1 origin/main updates can reject as non-fast-forward after merges; allow the forced ref update so checkout can proceed.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
diffText:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
index 493496b..432b5b6 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ jobs:
             cd "$APP_DIR"
             git remote set-url origin https://github.com/fireweave-HQ-Demo/arcade.git
             # Explicit refspec so shallow clones create origin/<branch> (needed when switching main ↔ fw-base).
-            git fetch --depth=1 origin "refs/heads/${BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${BRANCH}"
+            git fetch --depth=1 origin "+refs/heads/${BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${BRANCH}"
             git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "origin/${BRANCH}"
             git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
             echo "deploying branch=$BRANCH sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
